title: Blue Crab Chesapeake Sailing Charters

services.name: Cruise Details
services.desc: Just $35.00 per person payable by cash or check at the dock! (Four pp minimum) Group rate is $210.00 for 5 or 6 passengers. Maximum of 6 passengers. Standard cruises are 90 minutes. Private, extended and custom cruises are also available. Management has the right to cancel or reschedule any cruise due to weather or other issue. There is no age restriction to sail. blurb: Guests sail from Rock Hall Harbor on the 43 foot Morgan center cockpit sailboat "Island Girl." They can take the helm or relax while sailing. The company operates from April through October, seven days a week, up to five times daily.
